name: Finding A Good Husband
overview: Scripture reveals that God designed marriage as a divine provision for companionship, as He declared it is not good for man to be alone and made a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). A good husband is found through God's favor, and marriage involves a sacred union where a man leaves his parents and cleaves to his wife, becoming one flesh (Genesis 2:24; Proverbs 18:22). Believers are encouraged to wait on the Lord with courage and to set their minds on heavenly things rather than earthly desires (Psalms 27:14; Colossians 3:2), recognizing the value of a virtuous spouse whose worth surpasses all earthly riches (Proverbs 31:10).
